column3: “Hometown” specifies where Lazarus was; He replaces the repeated Jesus.
BSB’s “She has kept” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “so that she may keep it” (τηρήσῃ).
“Them” is supplied as those being deserted.
The order of remembering what was written and what was done is reversed.
The crowd is expanded to many people, and the when clause becomes part of the testimony.
“This appeal” supplies the content; the first comes is not expressed.
